cues: Marks depend on the whole key.
But name and faculty depend on roll alone, only part of the key: a partial dependency.
And the faculty head depends on faculty, a non-key column: a transitive dependency.
These cause anomalies: data repeated, and things you cannot insert or delete cleanly.
